mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_no, o.category_id, c.name as category_name, o.premise_id, concat(ifnull(p.community, ''), ifnull(p.building, ''), ifnull(p.unit, ''), ifnull(p.room_no, '')) as premise_address, o.resident_id, r.name as resident_name, r.phone as resident_phone, o.title, o.description, o.priority, o.status, o.source, o.expect_time, o.assignee_id, s.name as assignee_name, o.response_deadline, o.resolve_deadline, o.total_amount, o.response_breached, o.resolve_breached, o.is_rework, o.rework_count, o.rating, o.comment, o.create_time

from wo_order o left join wo_category c on c.id = o.category_id left join sys_premise p on p.id = o.premise_id left join sys_resident r on r.id = o.resident_id left join sys_staff s on s.id = o.assignee_id
mapper.select: select * from wo_order where status in (1,2,3,4,5,6,8) and ( (ifnull(response_breached, 0) = 0 and response_deadline is not null and response_deadline < #{now} and status in (1,2,3)) or (ifnull(resolve_breached, 0) = 0 and resolve_deadline is not null and resolve_deadline < #{now} and status in (4,5,6,8)) ) order by priority desc limit 200

select * from wo_order where status in (1,2,3,4,5,6,8) and resolve_deadline is not null and ifnull(resolve_breached, 0) = 0 and resolve_deadline >= #{from} and resolve_deadline <= #{to} order by resolve_deadline limit 100
select avg(timestampdiff(minute, create_time, accept_time)) from wo_order where accept_time is not null and create_time >= #{begin} and create_time < #{end}

select ifnull( sum(case when ifnull(resolve_breached, 0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / nullif(count(*), 0), 0) from wo_order where status = 7 and complete_time >= #{begin} and complete_time < #{end}
select status, count(*) as count from wo_order where create_time >= #{begin} and create_time < #{end} group by status order by status

select c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, count(o.id) as count from wo_category c left join wo_order o on o.category_id = c.id and o.create_time >= #{begin} and o.create_time < #{end} group by c.id, c.name order by count desc

select count(*) as total, sum(case when ifnull(response_breached, 0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as response_on_time, ifnull(round(sum(case when ifnull(response_breached, 0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / nullif(count(*), 0), 2), 0) as response_rate, sum(case when status = 7 and ifnull(resolve_breached, 0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as resolve_on_time, ifnull(round(sum(case when status = 7 and ifnull(resolve_breached, 0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(case when status = 7 then 1 else 0 end), 0), 2), 0) as resolve_rate, ifnull(round(avg(case when accept_time is not null then timestampdiff(minute, create_time, accept_time) end), 1), 0) as avg_response_minutes, ifnull(round(avg(case when finish_time is not null then timestampdiff(minute, create_time, finish_time) end), 1), 0) as avg_resolve_minutes from wo_order where create_time >= #{begin} and create_time < #{end}

select s.id as staff_id, s.name as staff_name, count(o.id) as total, sum(case when o.status = 7 then 1 else 0 end) as completed, ifnull(round(avg(case when o.finish_time is not null then timestampdiff(minute, o.accept_time, o.finish_time) end), 1), 0) as avg_resolve_minutes, ifnull(round(sum(case when o.status = 7 and ifnull(o.resolve_breached, 0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(case when o.status = 7 then 1 else 0 end), 0), 2), 0) as on_time_rate, ifnull(round(avg(o.rating), 1), 0) as avg_rating from sys_staff s left join wo_order o on o.assignee_id = s.id and o.create_time >= #{begin} and o.create_time < #{end} where s.role = 2 group by s.id, s.name order by total desc
